one_line: Last Brahman ruler of Sindh, who resisted the early Umayyad advance at Debal and along the Indus.

appearance.age_look: Late 30s to early 40s, tall and lean with a warrior’s build.
appearance.face: Oval face with a straight nose, medium-deep wheatish complexion, neatly trimmed mustache and short beard along the jawline, a thin vertical sandalwood tilak on the forehead; default expression calm, resolute and slightly stern.
appearance.hair: Thick, straight black hair gathered into a high topknot at the back of the crown, with a few controlled strands framing the temples; a narrow gold circlet with a small central red gem sits low on the forehead, partially over the tilak.
appearance.costume: He wears a long, straight-cut Sindhi-style tunic (kurtaka) of matte off-white cotton reaching just above the knees with side slits, over which is a sleeveless fitted coat of quilted cotton or light leather dyed deep maroon, secured by a brown leather belt with a simple bronze buckle; his lower garment is a wrapped dhoti in muted saffron with a fine maroon border, pleated in front and drawn between the legs for riding, paired with snug dark brown leather boots reaching mid-calf, laced at the front; over one shoulder is a dark indigo woolen shawl with subtle narrow geometric borders in white and maroon, draped diagonally and pinned with a small bronze brooch; arms bear simple bronze armlets and a single thick bangle on the right wrist, while small gold stud earrings and a plain amulet cord at the neck hint at royal yet restrained jewelry.
appearance.signature: A long, slightly curved steel sword with a simple crossguard and disc pommel, sheathed in a brown leather scabbard with understated bronze fittings, worn at his left hip and held in his right hand when posed.

ref_desc: Raja Dahir is a tall, wheatish-complexioned man in his early 40s with a topknot, tilak-marked forehead and gold circlet, wearing an off-white tunic, maroon sleeveless coat, saffron dhoti, indigo shawl and brown boots, carrying a simple curved steel sword at his left hip.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Raja Dahir: a tall, lean man in his early 40s with an oval face, wheatish complexion, straight nose, neatly trimmed mustache and short beard, and a calm, resolute expression; his thick black hair is pulled into a high topknot with a few strands at the temples, and a narrow gold circlet with a tiny red gem sits low on his forehead over a thin vertical sandalwood tilak; he wears an off-white straight-cut tunic just above the knees, over a sleeveless fitted quilted maroon coat belted with a brown leather belt, a wrapped muted saffron dhoti with a fine maroon border arranged for riding, dark brown mid-calf leather boots, and a dark indigo woolen shawl with subtle white and maroon geometric borders draped over one shoulder and pinned with a bronze brooch; he has simple bronze armlets, one thick bangle on his right wrist, small gold stud earrings and a plain amulet cord, and at his left hip hangs a long, slightly curved steel sword in a brown leather scabbard with bronze fittings which he holds in his right hand; show front, side and back views, keeping all colors and details consistent and clearly visible.
